derivation.generation: row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY plan_id, role ORDER BY created_at, id) — the D1 §7.2 spine, shared with W-B6
derivation.closure_reason_effective: coalesce(ticket.closure_reason, 'expiry_detection' when an expiry event exists, 'status:'||status) — computed in this log, never written back to the ticket
derivation.disposition_rules: expired + event → expired_with_event; expired + no event → expired_without_event_waived (waiver_ref required); open/claimed/stale with expires_at < swept_at → open_past_expiry_disposed; everything else → no_disposition_required
derivation.spine_sql: WITH events AS ( SELECT aggregate_id AS ticket_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload->>'reason' = 'expiry_detection')::int AS expiry_events FROM kernel.transition_event GROUP BY aggregate_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT t.plan_id, t.role, t.id AS ticket_id, t.status, t.created_at, t.expires_at, t.closed_at, t.closure_reason, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.plan_id, t.role ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id ) AS generation, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.plan_id, t.role) AS generations_total FROM vision.tickets t WHERE t.plan_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT r.plan_id, r.role, r.generation, r.generations_total, r.ticket_id, r.status, r.created_at, r.expires_at, r.closed_at, r.closure_reason, COALESCE(e.expiry_events, 0) AS expiry_events FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN events e ON e.ticket_id = r.ticket_id ORDER BY r.plan_id, r.role, r.generation

deltas_vs_baseline.note: Baselines are the blueprint's 2026-11-17 stamp (R-F12). Ticket rows/plans move with lane history; each delta is reported, never silently absorbed.

waivers.ruling_title: RULING: waive pre-fix terminal gaps; never synthesize historical transition events
waivers.scope: expired generations whose expires_at lies in 2026-06-18..2026-07-26, before the emission fix (PR #560); no row created after the fix is admitted, and no transition event was synthesized

S5_live_open_generations.note: live_open_generations is reported verbatim; the D1 baseline of 0 is not forced when lane tickets are open inside their window
